Uttarakhand Youths Secure Overseas Jobs, Language Training Provided

One hundred and six youths from Uttarakhand have secured employment opportunities abroad, with 75 jobs in Japan and others in Germany. To facilitate this, 58 centers across the state are providing training in German and Japanese languages. This initiative is attributed to efforts by Chief Minister Dhami.
